item.description: A child for the Gegeneis: Ostemenes Neogenides ~2735, born to Neogenes #4435 the Twice-Born and Eukles #4987. It will grow old; its parents will not.

item.title: Aridoros #3902 was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel
item.description: Aridoros #3902 was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
